name: Training Plan
description: Tell your AI your sport, level, goal and days, and get a week of sessions with warm-ups, sets and tips. Tick them off as you go.
prompt: A training planner with the AI: choose a sport, level, training days and goal, and get a seven-day plan with session names, intensity, minutes and detailed steps, rest days, tips, ticks for completed sessions, next week's plan that progresses from the last one, and sharing.
author: gonzaroman
